snippet.title: Har Jod Par Roz Ek Sadqah! | Sahih Bukhari 2989 | Bina Paisay Ke 5 Sadqay #shorts
snippet.description:
Aap ke jism ke har jod par, roz ek sadqah hai. Aur paisa ek bhi nahin lagta.

Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) ne farmaya (Abu Huraira Radi Allahu Anhu se riwayat):
«كُلُّ سُلَامَى مِنَ النَّاسِ عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ تَطْلُعُ فِيهِ الشَّمْسُ»
"Har din jab sooraj nikalta hai, insaan ke har jod par sadqah hai."
Do logon mein insaaf karna sadqah hai, kisi ko sawari par chadhne ya us par saamaan uthane mein madad karna sadqah hai, achhi baat sadqah hai, namaz ki taraf har qadam sadqah hai, aur raaste se takleef dene wali cheez hatana sadqah hai.

Reference
• Sahih al-Bukhari 2989: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:2989

Aaj ka sadqah: ek achhi baat, aur raaste se ek pathar. Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
